x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"custom_field_lov_entries\":[{\"label\":\"Field-Label-23\"}]}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/custom_field_definitions/%7Bcustom_field_definition_id%7D/custom_field_lov_entries/bulk_create", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
